40014179.author: पदार्थः
40014179.content: काकुत्स्थ: scion of Kakuthsa dynasty, सुग्रीवस्य: of Sugriva, हेतुमत्: wellmeaning, परमार्थवत्: one who spoke the truth with deep understanding, वचः words, श्श्रुत्वा: having heard, प्रतिजग्राह: having accepted, अथ: then, हनूमन्तम्: at Hanuman, अब्रवीत्: said

40014179.author: Translation
40014179.content: Rama the scion of Kakuthsa dynasty having accepted the wellmeaning words of Sugriva, who spoke the truth with deep understanding, turned to Hanuman and said.

40014180.author: पदार्थः
40014180.content: तपसा: by austerity, सेतुबन्धेन: construction of bridge, सागरोच्छोणेनच: or by drying the ocean, सर्वथापि: any other way, अस्यसागरस्य: that ocean's, लङ्घने: to cross, सुसमर्थः highly capable, अस्मि: I am.

40014180.author: Translation
40014180.content: "By austerity or by drying up the ocean or by any other means, I am capable of crossing the ocean."

40014181.author: पदार्थः
40014181.content: वानर: vanara, दुर्गायाः forts, लङ्कायाः in Lanka, कति: how many, दुर्गाणि: difficult to access, सर्वम्: totally, दर्शनादिव: just as you have seen, ज्ञातुम्: to know, इच्छामि: I wish, तानि: all that, ब्रूहि: tell me

40014181.author: Translation
40014181.content: "O Vanara How many forts are in Lanka? You may tell me whatever you have seen. I wish to know all that."

40014182.author: पदार्थः
40014182.content: बलस्य: of the strength of army, परिमाणंच: the size, द्वारदुर्गक्रियामपि: the gateways that are difficult to enter, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, गुप्तिकर्मच: the way in which the entrances have been protected, रक्षसाम्: by the rakshasas, सदनानिच: and the dwellings, यथासुखम्: very conveniently, यथावच्च: tell in detail लङ्कायाम्:  in Lanka, दृष्टवान्: one who has seen, असि: to me, सर्वम्: all,तत्त्वेन: truly, आचक्षय: you are aware, सर्वथा: in all aspects, कुशलः you are capable, असिहि: indeed to me

40014182.author: Translation
40014182.content: "Tell me in detail about the strength and size of the army, the number of gateways that are difficult to enter, the way in which the entrances have been protected by the rakshasas, and their dwellings in Lanka. Indeed you are aware of all aspects and are also capable."

40014183.author: पदार्थः
40014183.content: बलस्य: of the strength of army, परिमाणंच: the size, द्वारदुर्गक्रियामपि: the gateways that are difficult to enter, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, गुप्तिकर्मच: the way in which the entrances have been protected, रक्षसाम्: by the rakshasas, सदनानिच: and the dwellings, यथासुखम्: very conveniently, यथावच्च: tell in detail लङ्कायाम्:  in Lanka, दृष्टवान्: one who has seen, असि: to me, सर्वम्: all,तत्त्वेन: truly, आचक्षय: you are aware, सर्वथा: in all aspects, कुशलः you are capable, असिहि: indeed to me

40014183.author: Translation
40014183.content: "Tell me in detail about the strength and size of the army, the number of gateways that are difficult to enter, the way in which the entrances have been protected by the rakshasas, and their dwellings in Lanka. Indeed you are aware of all aspects and are also capable."

40014184.author: पदार्थः
40014184.content: वाक्यविदाम्: among those who are good in speech, श्रेष्ठः foremost, मारुतात्मजः son of Maruti, हनुमान्: Hanuman, रामस्य: Rama's, वचनम्: words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, अथ: then, पुनः again, रामम्: to Rama, अब्रवीत्: said

40014184.author: Translation
40014184.content: Hanuman the son of Maruti, the foremost among those who are good at speech, having heard Rama's words again said to Rama.

40014185.author: पदार्थः
40014185.content: लङ्कापुरी: city of Lanka, यथा: so also, दुर्गकर्मविधानतः the way in which, it is fortified, गुप्ता: secret , बलैः forces, यथा: that way, रक्षिताच: and protected, सर्वम्: everything, आख्यास्ये: relate, श्रूयताम्: wish to hear

40014185.author: Translation
40014185.content: "I will relate the way in which the city of Lanka is fortified, the way in which it is protected by secret forces, everything you wish to hear."

40014186.author: पदार्थः
40014186.content: राक्षसाः rakshasas, यथा: like that, स्निग्द्धा: affection, रावणस्य: Ravana's , तेजसा: power, लङ्कायाः in Lanka, पराम्: superior, समृद्धिम्: abundance, सागरस्य: ocean's, भीमताम्: terrifying, बलौघस्य: army,विभागम्: divisions, वाहनस्य: the means of transport, like chariots, elephants horses and soldiers, निर्देशंच: and point out, तत्त्ववित: as it truly is, कपिश्रेष्ठःforemost of vanaras, एवम्: in that way, उक्त्वा: tell, कथयामास: every thing

40014186.author: Translation
40014186.content: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras said that he will truly point out everything in Lanka:"Ravana's power, the affection of rakshasas to Ravana, his prosperity, the terrifying ocean, the divisions of the army such as chariots, elephants, horses and soldiers."

40014187.author: पदार्थः
40014187.content: राक्षसाः rakshasas, यथा: like that, स्निग्द्धा: affection, रावणस्य: Ravana's , तेजसा: power, लङ्कायाः in Lanka, पराम्: superior, समृद्धिम्: abundance, सागरस्य: ocean's, भीमताम्: terrifying, बलौघस्य: army,विभागम्: divisions, वाहनस्य: the means of transport, like chariots, elephants horses and soldiers, निर्देशंच: and point out, तत्त्ववित: as it truly is, कपिश्रेष्ठःforemost of vanaras, एवम्: in that way, उक्त्वा: tell, कथयामास: every thing

40014187.author: Translation
40014187.content: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras said that he will truly point out everything in Lanka:"Ravana's power, the affection of rakshasas to Ravana, his prosperity, the terrifying ocean, the divisions of the army such as chariots, elephants, horses and soldiers."

40014188.author: पदार्थः
40014188.content: महती: vast, लङ्का: Lanka, हृष्टप्रमुदिता: very delighted, मत्तद्विपसमाकुला: full of elephants in rut, रथसंपूर्णा: filled with chariots, रक्षोगणसमाकुला: filled with innumerable rakshasas

40014188.author: Translation
40014188.content: "The people in the vast island of Lanka are very delighted. Lanka is filled with chariots and innumerable rakshasas."

40014189.author: पदार्थः
40014189.content: अस्याः in that Lanka, सुमहान्ति: lofty, विपुलानि: wide, चत्वारि: courtyards, द्वाराणि: entrances, दृढबद्धकवाटानि: doors fixed with metal fixtures , महापरिघवन्तिच: with large iron bars

40014189.author: Translation
40014189.content: "Lanka is endowed with lofty wide courtyards, entrances with doors that are fixed with metal fixtures and large iron bars."

40014190.author: पदार्थः
40014190.content: तत्र: there , बलवन्ति: powerful, महान्तिच: and large, इषूपलयान्त्राणि: machines that release darts and stones, तत्र: there, आगतम्: when they reach , परसैन्यम्: enemy's army, तैः those, प्रतिनिवार्यते: will retaliate and destroy

40014190.author: Translation
40014190.content: "The doors are fitted with powerful machines which retaliate by discharging darts and stones on the enemy's army and kill them."

40014191.author: पदार्थः
40014191.content: संस्कृताः made ready, भीमाः terrific, कालयसमयाः fearful rakshasas ,श्शिताः sharpened, शतशः one hundred, शतघ्नयः huge stones studded with iron spikes , रक्षसाम्: guards, गणैः troops, द्वारेषु: at the entrance, रचिताः kept ready

40014191.author: Translation
40014191.content: At the entrances are troops of terrific looking guards kept ready with a hundred sharpened stones studded with iron spikes.

40014192.author: पदार्थः
40014192.content: तस्याः its, सौवर्णः golden , महान्: lofty, मणीविद्रुमवैदूर्यमुक्ताविरचितान्तरः encrusted here and there with gems, corals and Vaiduryas and pearls, प्राकारः boundary wall, दुष्पधर्षणः difficult to assail

40014192.author: Translation
40014192.content: "Its lofty golden boundary wall encrusted here and there with gems, corals, Vaiduryas and pearls is difficult to assail."

40014193.author: पदार्थः
40014193.content: सर्वताः all round it, महाभीमाः very frightening, शीततोयाः very cold water, महाशुभाः very splendid, अगाधाः fathomless, ग्राहवत्यश्च: crocodiles, मीनसेविताः inhabited by fish, परिखा: moats

40014193.author: Translation
40014193.content: All round it (boundary wall) are very splendid moats filled with frighteningcold water inhabited by fish and crocodiles.

40014194.author: पदार्थः
40014194.content: द्वारेषु: at the entrance of gateways,चत्वार: on four sides, परमायताः very extensive, बहुभिः huge, यन्त्रै: engines, महद्भि: huge,गृहपङ्क्तिभिः rows of houses, उपेताः when people approach, तासां: movable bridges, सङ्क्रमाः four roadways

40014194.author: Translation
40014194.content: At the entrance of the gateways around the moats are four road ways. Huge engines are fixed to move the bridges when people approach. There are rows of houses (for the guards) at the gateways.

40014195.author: पदार्थः
40014195.content: तत्र: there, परसैन्यागतेसति: when enemy army enters, सङ्क्रमाः road ways, त्रायन्ते: protected, समन्ततः all over, परिखासु: in the moats, तैः those, यन्त्रै: those engines, अपकीर्यन्ते: not possible to cross

40014195.author: Translation
40014195.content: "When the enemy arrives, the engines all over the moats lift the bridges making entry impossible for enemy armies."

40014196.author: पदार्थः
40014196.content: काञ्चनै: golden, बहुभिः many, स्तम्भै: pillars, वेदिकाभिश्च: altars , शोभितः shining, बलवान्: strong, सुमहादृढः steady, एकः one, सङ्क्रमस्तु: road way, अकम्प्यः not shaky

40014196.author: Translation
40014196.content: "One of the road ways is very strong and steady, shining with unshakeable golden pillars and altars."

40014197.author: पदार्थः
40014197.content: राम: O Rama, स्वयम्: Ravana himself , युयुत्सुः one with hostile intention, प्रकृतिम्: assuming natural tendency, आपन्नः one who has adopted, रावणः Ravana, उत्थितश्च: eager to combat, बलानाम्: army, अनुदर्शने: looks after, अप्रमत्तश्च: ever very alert

40014197.author: Translation
40014197.content: "O Rama Ravana, who is hostile in his intentions, assuming his natural tendency which is eagerness to combat, is always very alert and looks after the army."

40014198.author: पदार्थः
40014198.content: देवदुर्गा: difficult for devatas to access, निरालम्बा: being located on peak of mountain, लङ्का: Lanka, पुनः again, भयावहा: fierce, नादेयम्: rivers, पार्वतम्: mountains, वान्यम्: forests, कृत्रिमंच: and artificial fortress, चतुर्विधम्: four kinds

40014198.author: Translation
40014198.content: "Lanka is difficult to access even for devatas located on high peaks of the mountain. It is fierce to onlookers, surrounded by four kinds of forts, like rivers, mountains, forests and artificial fortresses."

40014199.author: पदार्थः
40014199.content: राघव: O Raghava, दूरपारस्य: difficult to cross, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, पारे: other shore, स्थिता: located, अत्र: there, नौपथोपिश्च: passage for ships, नास्ति: not possible, सर्वशः all over, निरादेशश्च: nothing around.

40014199.author: Translation
40014199.content: "O Raghava Lanka is located on the other shore of the ocean. Passage through the sea is not possible. It is away from all and there is nothing around."

40014200.author: पदार्थः
40014200.content: दुर्गा: inaccessible, देवपुरोपमा: like the abode of devatas, सा: that, पुरै: city, शैलाग्रे: peak of the mountain, रचिता: to prepare, वाजिवारणसम्पूर्णा: full of horses and elephants, सा: that, लङ्का: Lanka, परमदुर्जया: difficult for anyone to conquer

40014200.author: Translation
40014200.content: "It is inaccessible like the abode of devatas as it is on the peak of the mountain. It is difficult to conquer for any one as it is full of horses and elephants."

40014201.author: पदार्थः
40014201.content: दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य: Ravana's, पुरीम्: city, लङ्काम्: of Lanka, परिखाश्च: by moats, शतघ्नयश्च: by missiles विविधानि: of many kinds, यन्त्राणिच: and machinery, शोभयन्ति: is shining

40014201.author: Translation
40014201.content: "Evil minded Ravana's city of Lanka is shining with moats and missiles of many kinds and machinery."

40014202.author: पदार्थः
40014202.content: अत्र:there, रक्षसाम्: rakshasas, अयुतम्: ten thousand, पूर्वद्वारम्: eastern gate, समाश्रितम्: garrisoned there , सर्वे: all, शूलहस्ताः those wielding tridents, दुराधर्षाः unassailable in war, खङ्गाग्रयोधिनः stand in front and fight with swords

40014202.author: Translation
40014202.content: "There(in Lanka) ten thousand warriors are garrisoned at the eastern gate way holding tridents, and those who are unassailable in war stand in front with swords."

40014203.author: पदार्थः
40014203.content: अत्र: there, रक्षसा: rakshasas, नियुतम्: one lakh , दक्षिणद्वारम्: at the southern gateway, आश्रितम्: garrisoned, तत्रापि: they are also, चतुरङ्गेण: with four divisions of army , सैन्येन: with army, योधाः warriors, अनुत्तमाः best ones

40014203.author: Translation
40014203.content: At the southern gate also one lakh of rakshasas are garrisoned with four divisions of army. They are also the best warriors.

40014204.author: पदार्थः
40014204.content: अत्र: there, रक्षसाम्: the rakshasas, प्रयुतम्: ten lakhs, पश्चिमद्वारम्: western gate, आश्रितम्: garrisoned, सर्वे: all, चर्मखङ्गधराः: wearing shields of skin and holding swords, तथा: that way, सर्वास्त्रकोविदाः knowledgeable in  several weapons.

40014204.author: Translation
40014204.content: At the western gate are garrisoned ten lakhs of rakshasas wearing shields of skin and holding swords. They are knowledgeable in several weapons.

40014205.author: पदार्थः
40014205.content: अत्र: there, रक्षसाम्: rakshasas, न्यर्बुदम्: one hundred crores, उत्तरद्वारम्: northern gate, अपि: even, आश्रितम्: garrisoned, रथिनः charioteers, अश्ववाहाश्च: horse riders and elephant riders,सुपूजिताः well respected trust worthy ones, कुलपुत्राः born in noble families

40014205.author: Translation
40014205.content: At the northern gate(of Lanka) are garrisoned one hundred crores of rakshasas constituting, charioteers, horse riding and elephant riding ogres born of noble families, respected and trustworthy (for Ravana).

40014206.author: पदार्थः
40014206.content: अथ: and , शतशः hundreds, सहस्राणि: thousands, दुराधर्षाः unassailable in war, यातुधानाः warriors, मध्यमस्कन्धम्: in the center of the city, आश्रिताः collected, रक्षसाम्: ogres, साग्रकोटिश्च: in multitude of crores

40014206.author: Translation
40014206.content: "Hundreds and thousands of warriors who are unassailable are collected in the center(of Lanka) in multitudes of crores."

40014207.author: पदार्थः
40014207.content: मया: by me, ते: those, सङ्क्रमाः the road ways, भग्नाः destroyed, परिखाश्च: and even moats, अवपूरिताः filled up, लङ्कानगरी: city of Lanka, दग्दाच: burnt also , प्राकाराश्च: even boundary walls, अवसादिताः smashed, महात्मनाम्: very powerful ones, राक्षसानाम्: rakshasas,बलैकदेशः part of the army, क्षपितः killed

40014207.author: Translation
40014207.content: "I have destroyed some of those roadways, even filled up the moats, burnt parts of the city of Lanka, smashed the boundary walls and killed part of the powerful army."

40014208.author: पदार्थः
40014208.content: येनकेनतु: by whatever means , मार्गेण: passage, वरुणालयम्: the ocean, abode of Varuna, तराम: cross over , वानरैः vanaras, लङ्कानगरी: Lanka city, हताइति: has destroyed, अवधार्यताम्: taken as destroyed

40014208.author: Translation
40014208.content: "If by whatever means the passage of ocean can be crossed by vanaras it can be taken for granted that the city of Lanka is destroyed."

40014209.author: पदार्थः
40014209.content: राघव: Raghava, बलशेषेण: with the rest of the army, तव: your, किम्: why, अङ्गदः Angada, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, जाम्बवान्: Jambavan, पनसः Panasa, अनलः Anala, सेनापतिः chief of the army, नीलश्चैव: even Nila, प्लवमानाः reaching by leaping, गत्वासपर्वतावनाम्: going over the mountains , सखाताम्: outer gates, सप्रतोरणाम्: archways, सप्राकाराम्: those boundaries, सभवनाम्: and the buildings, ताम्: those, रावणस्यमहापुरीम्: Ravana's city, भित्त्वा: demolishing, आनयिष्यन्ति: will get

40014209.author: Translation
40014209.content: "Raghava What do we have to do with the rest of the army when Angada, Dwivida, Mainda, Jambavan, Panasa, Nala and the chief of the army Nila are there? Reaching Ravana's city by leaping over the mountains and demolishing the outer gates, other boundaries, archways and other buildings they will get into Lanka city."

40014210.author: पदार्थः
40014210.content: राघव: Raghava, बलशेषेण: with the rest of the army, तव: your, किम्: why, अङ्गदः Angada, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, जाम्बवान्: Jambavan, पनसः Panasa, अनलः Anala, सेनापतिः chief of the army, नीलश्चैव: even Nila, प्लवमानाः reaching by leaping, गत्वासपर्वतावनाम्: going over the mountains , सखाताम्: outer gates, सप्रतोरणाम्: archways, सप्राकाराम्: those boundaries, सभवनाम्: and the buildings, ताम्: those, रावणस्यमहापुरीम्: Ravana's city, भित्त्वा: demolishing, आनयिष्यन्ति: will get

40014210.author: Translation
40014210.content: "Raghava What do we have to do with the rest of the army when Angada, Dwivida, Mainda, Jambavan, Panasa, Nala and the chief of the army Nila are there? Reaching Ravana's city by leaping over the mountains and demolishing the outer gates, other boundaries, archways and other buildings they will get into Lanka city."

40014211.author: पदार्थः
40014211.content: राघव: Raghava, बलशेषेण: with the rest of the army, तव: your, किम्: why, अङ्गदः Angada, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, जाम्बवान्: Jambavan, पनसः Panasa, अनलः Anala, सेनापतिः chief of the army, नीलश्चैव: even Nila, प्लवमानाः reaching by leaping, गत्वासपर्वतावनाम्: going over the mountains , सखाताम्: outer gates, सप्रतोरणाम्: archways, सप्राकाराम्: those boundaries, सभवनाम्: and the buildings, ताम्: those, रावणस्यमहापुरीम्: Ravana's city, भित्त्वा: demolishing, आनयिष्यन्ति: will get

40014211.author: Translation
40014211.content: "Raghava What do we have to do with the rest of the army when Angada, Dwivida, Mainda, Jambavan, Panasa, Nala and the chief of the army Nila are there? Reaching Ravana's city by leaping over the mountains and demolishing the outer gates, other boundaries, archways and other buildings they will get into Lanka city."

40014212.author: पदार्थः
40014212.content: एवम्: in that way, बलानाम्: the army, सर्वसङ्ग्रहम्: who the total, क्षिप्रम्: quickly, आज्ञापय: command, युक्तेनप्रस्थानम्: start at opportune time, अभिरोचय: you may command

40014212.author: Translation
40014212.content: "You may command the total army this way."Quickly start at an opportune time towards Lanka (said Hanuman to Rama)" commanded Hanuman." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेतृतीयस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the third Sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
